newsitem.title: USA: Supreme sees Q4 rev growth more than 40 pct.
newsitem.headline: Supreme sees Q4 rev growth more than 40 pct.

text.p: Supreme International Corp, which markets men's and boy's sportwear, said Monday it expects its fourth quarter revenue growth to exceed 40 percent.
In the 1995 fourth quarter, Supreme posted revenues of $25.6 million.
Supreme sees continued growth in its Natural Issue line, as well as its Jolem and Munsingwear brands.
"Munsingwear will be a strong contributor to revenues and earnings as we ramp up deliveries in coming quarters," the company said.
Supreme closed on the acquisition of Munsingwear's trademarks in September.
